answer: To prevent Sybil flooding, the network models identities as a reef of interdependent trusts: an orchard of clustered validator agents conducts game-theoretic multi-agent auditing using topological cut verifications. Each juniper verification layer imposes superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^2)$ stake requirements.
